description: JANAVI (Papermark fork) Prisma data model — models, relations, enums. 15 schema files in prisma/schema/, 134 migrations. Datasource: postgresql via POSTGRES_PRISMA_URL (+NON_POOLING directUrl, SHADOW for migrations). Maintained per sprint; update after schema changes.

tenant_model.root: Team (team.prisma) — every user-facing entity hangs off teamId
tenant_model.membership: UserTeam (userId+teamId, Role enum ADMIN|MANAGER|MEMBER|DATAROOM_MEMBER, status, blockedAt)
tenant_model.room_scoping: UserDataroom (userId+dataroomId) scopes DATAROOM_MEMBER to specific rooms

document_pipeline.Document: document.prisma — name, file (primary/converted key), originalFile (source pptx/docx/...), type, contentType, storageType (enum S3_PATH|VERCEL_BLOB), numPages, ownerId->User(SetNull), teamId->Team(Cascade), folderId->Folder, downloadOnly, hiddenInAllDocuments, assistantEnabled, advancedExcelEnabled; relations: links, versions, datarooms(DataroomDocument), annotations, redactionJobs, uploadedDocument(DocumentUpload), tags Added 2026-10-20 (agreements): agreementType String? (NDA|MSA|SOW|SLA|PARTNERSHIP|VENDOR|EMPLOYMENT|OTHER), agreementStatus String? default DRAFT (SHARING lifecycle DRAFT|SHARED|VIEWED|EXPIRED|REVOKED — never signature statuses), agreementMeta Json?; @@index([teamId, agreementType]) — migration 20261019192700_add_agreement_metadata (additive only).
document_pipeline.DocumentVersion: versionNumber @@unique([versionNumber,documentId]), file, originalFile, fileSize BigInt, storageType, numPages, isPrimary, isVertical, fileId/vectorStoreFileId (OpenAI), hasPages, length (video seconds), pages DocumentPage[]
document_pipeline.DocumentPage: versionId->DocumentVersion, pageNumber @@unique([pageNumber,versionId]), file (page-image key), storageType, pageLinks Json (href/coords overlays), embeddedLinks String[], metadata Json (width/height/scaleFactor)
document_pipeline.DocumentUpload: visitor uploads via link (document/view/link/dataroom refs, originalFilename, mimeType)

sharing.Link: link.prisma — linkType enum DOCUMENT_LINK|DATAROOM_LINK|WORKFLOW_LINK; url @unique, slug @@unique([domainSlug,slug]); expiresAt; password (bcrypt or salt:hash AES-256-CTR); allowList/denyList String[]; emailProtected default true; emailAuthenticated; allowDownload; enableWatermark+watermarkConfig Json; enableScreenshotProtection; enableConfidentialView; enableAgreement; enableNotification/Feedback/Question/Conversation/AIAgents; enableCustomMetatag+meta*; audienceType enum GENERAL|GROUP|TEAM + groupId->ViewerGroup; permissionGroupId->PermissionGroup; upload settings (enableUpload, isFileRequestOnly, uploadFolderIds, enableIndexFile); brandId->Brand; ownerId->User('LinkOwner'); customFields CustomField[] Added 2026-10-20 (native e-signature, migration 20261020000000_add_native_signing): requireSignature Boolean default false, signatureFieldConfiguration Json? ({methods:[DRAW|TYPE|UPLOAD], fields:[{fieldId,type,pageNumber,x,y,width,height,required}]} normalized 0-1, y from top), signatureVerificationRequired Boolean default true (forced true while requireSignature), signatureConsentRequired Boolean default true; signatureRecords SignatureRecord[]
sharing.LinkPreset: per-team default link settings incl. watermark + agreement + custom fields
sharing.CustomField: enum CustomFieldType SHORT_TEXT..MULTI_SELECT; CustomFieldResponse unique per view
sharing.VisitorGroup: team-level email/domain allow lists; LinkVisitorGroup join; ViewerGroupMembership (dataroom side)

views_and_viewers.View: schema.prisma — linkId(Cascade), documentId?, dataroomId?, dataroomViewId? (per-doc view inside dataroom session), viewerEmail/viewerName, verified, viewedAt @default(now()), downloadedAt, downloadType enum SINGLE|BULK|FOLDER, downloadMetadata Json, viewType enum DOCUMENT_VIEW|DATAROOM_VIEW, viewerId->Viewer, groupId->ViewerGroup; indexed [documentId,viewedAt desc]
views_and_viewers.Viewer: known recipient @@unique([teamId,email]), verified, invitedAt, notificationPreferences Json
views_and_viewers.VerificationToken: identifier + token @unique + expires — reused for OTP codes (otp:{linkId}:{email}, 10min) and 23h link-verification tokens

dataroom.Dataroom: dataroom.prisma — pId @unique (dr_*), internalName, DataroomBrand, defaultPermissionStrategy enum INHERIT_FROM_PARENT|ASK_EVERY_TIME|HIDDEN_BY_DEFAULT, defaultRootItemAccess enum VIEW_ONLY|VIEW_AND_DOWNLOAD|HIDDEN, allowBulkDownload, showLastUpdated, introduction (TipTap Json), freeze fields (isFrozen/frozenAt/frozenArchiveUrl/hash), requestListEnabled, conversations/Q&A/FAQ toggles, agentsEnabled
dataroom.TaskList/Task/TaskAssignment/TaskActivit: request-list system; Task type TODO|UPLOAD|ACKNOWLEDGE, status OPEN..COMPLETED (string, Zod-validated)

auth_and_team.Invitation: team invite, token @unique, Role, dataroomIds String[] for DATAROOM_MEMBER scoping
auth_and_team.Team: plan, stripe lifecycle, limits Json (datarooms/users/domains/fileSizeLimits), ssoEnabled/ssoEmailDomain/ssoEnforcedAt, ignoredDomains/globalBlockList String[]

models.branding: Brand (brand.prisma) — per-team @@unique([teamId,name]): logo, hideLogo, banner, brandColor, accentColor, accentButtonColor, welcomeMessage, ctaLabel/Url, cardLayout enum LIST|COMPACT|GRID, viewerLayoutPreset enum STANDARD|STRICT|MODERN|NOTION, OG overrides, defaultLanguage; referenced by Link.brand, Dataroom (DataroomBrand override + DataroomBaseBrand), TeamDefaultBrand
models.qaa: Conversation (visibility enum PRIVATE|PUBLIC_LINK|PUBLIC_GROUP|PUBLIC_DOCUMENT|PUBLIC_DATAROOM), DataroomQuestion + DataroomQuestionAssignment (buy-side Q&A), ConversationParticipant, Message (isInternalNote), DataroomFaqItem
models.redactions: DocumentRedactionJob (Gemini coords, trigger ids) + DocumentRedaction (PII categories) — ee-licensed surface
models.integrations: Integration + InstalledIntegration (credentials Json @@unique([teamId,integrationId])); Webhook; IncomingWebhook; RestrictedToken (API keys, scopes, rateLimit); oauth.prisma OAuthClient/Approval/GrantTeam/Record (node-oidc-provider); jackson.prisma SAML/SCIM tables
models.notifications: NotificationPreference — types DOCUMENT_VIEW|DATAROOM_VIEW|BLOCKED_ACCESS|DATAROOM_UPLOAD|CONVERSATION_MESSAGE, frequency IMMEDIATE|NEVER, scope ALL|MINE_ONLY; SentEmail (+EmailType enum)
models.misc: Feedback/FeedbackResponse, Agreement/AgreementResponse (signedFileKey), YearInReview, Tag/TagItem, ViewerInvitation (enum SENT|FAILED|BOUNCED), Workflow/WorkflowStep/WorkflowExecution (ee), ReferralInvite

signatures.SignatureRecord: signature.prisma — one signing attempt per (link, viewerEmail): linkId->Link(Cascade), documentId->Document(Cascade), documentVersionId->DocumentVersion(Cascade) (primary version at signing time), viewId->View(SetNull), viewerEmail (lowercase), viewerId?, method enum SignatureMethod DRAW|TYPE|UPLOAD, status enum SignatureStatus PENDING|COMPLETED|FAILED, consentAcceptedAt?, signedAt?, signedFileKey? (private S3 key teamId/docId/signed-vN-linkId.pdf), signedFileHash?/originalFileHash? (SHA-256 hex), ipAddress?, userAgent?, fieldValues Json (text values only; images live only in the signed PDF); @@index([linkId, viewerEmail, status]) — idempotent per signer, stale PENDING (>5min) retryable
signatures.SignatureAuditEvent: append-only per record: type String CREATED|OTP_VERIFIED|CONSENT|SIGNED|FAILED (+VIEWED reserved), details Json (no secrets), @@index([signatureRecordId])
signatures._invariants: Recipient never receives original or signed PDF bytes (owner-gated endpoints only); signing requires a verified link session (emailAuthenticated forced on when requireSignature is saved)

key_relation_chains: Team 1-N Document 1-N DocumentVersion 1-N DocumentPage (page images per version; isPrimary picks active)
Document 1-N Link 1-N View N-1 Viewer (team-scoped recipient identity)
Dataroom N-N Document via DataroomDocument (+ DataroomFolder tree via materialized path)
Link N-1 Brand (per-link branding override); Dataroom 1-1 DataroomBrand + inherited team Brand
ViewerGroup/PermissionGroup -> AccessControls per item (folder/document) — effective permission = group controls override link defaults
VerificationToken doubles as OTP store and 23h verification tokens; Redis holds sessions (link_session:*, dataroom_session:*, preview_session:*)

storage_key_conventions.documents: {teamId}/{docId}/{slugified-filename} — tus namingFunction (pages/api/file/tus) ; team prefix enables tenant-scoped access checks in presign proxy
storage_key_conventions.regions: EU default + US variant (team feature flag usStorage) — buckets via NEXT_PRIVATE_UPLOAD_*(_US)
